mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_images ( place_id, image_url, thumbnail_url, caption, source, license_type, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{placeId}, #{imageUrl}, #{thumbnailUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{caption,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{source,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{licenseType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder,jdbcType=INTEGER}, 1) )
mapper.select: SELECT image_id, place_id, image_url, thumbnail_url, caption, source, license_type, sort_order FROM place_images WHERE place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY sort_order, image_id
